scripts.build:demo: npm run build && vite build --config examples/vanilla/vite.config.mjs
scripts.typegen:react: npm run build && node packages/typegen/dist/cli.js --locales-dir examples/vanilla/locales --base-locale ko --out-file examples/react/generated.d.ts
scripts.build:react: npm run typegen:react && tsc -p examples/react/tsconfig.json && vite build --config examples/react/vite.config.mjs
scripts.typegen:svelte: npm run build && node packages/typegen/dist/cli.js --locales-dir examples/svelte/locales --base-locale ko --out-file examples/svelte/generated.d.ts
scripts.build:svelte: npm run typegen:svelte && tsc -p examples/svelte/tsconfig.json && vite build --config examples/svelte/vite.config.mjs
scripts.setup:sveltekit: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/sveltekit ci --workspaces=false --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces && npm run typecheck:consumers --workspaces && node packages/typegen/dist/cli.js --locales-dir examples/vanilla/locales --base-locale ko --out-file examples/react/generated.d.ts && tsc -p examples/react/tsconfig.json && node --test scripts/test/verify-oidc.test.mjs scripts/test/registry-release.test.mjs
scripts.verify:demo:npm: npm --prefix examples/npm run build && node --test scripts/test/npm-demo-lifecycle.test.mjs
